description: The line plot illustrates the relative change in performance across different layers of a model for various token-precision configurations in KV cache compression, with the x-axis representing five distinct layer ranges—Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, and Layer29-32—and the y-axis showing the relative change in percentage, ranging from -25% to 5% with major ticks at intervals of 5%. The plot compares five configurations: LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit (yellow line with circular markers), LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit (red line with square markers), RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit (light blue line with circular markers), RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit (dark blue line with square markers), and a Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit (dashed gray line). The baseline remains flat at 0% across all layers. The LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit configuration starts at approximately -1%, remains relatively stable around -1% to 0% across all layers, and ends slightly above 0%. The LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit configuration begins at approximately -1%, dips to about -6% at Layer13-20, and then rises to around -1% at Layer29-32. The RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit configuration starts at approximately -2%, drops sharply to about -12% at Layer13-20, and then recovers to around -1% at Layer29-32. The RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit configuration starts at approximately -4%, plunges to a low of about -24% at Layer13-20, and then recovers to around -4% at Layer29-32.
